title: AI Payment Monitoring Agent: Save Your B2B Sales
body:
How many sales have you lost today without knowing it because your payment gateway failed?

You launch your campaign, the traffic arrives, but the bank account remains at zero. Small businesses and B2B e-commerce platforms lose fortunes due to invisible technical errors: an unresponsive webhook, a gateway trapped in test mode after an update, or a shared hosting firewall blocking the billing IP. The client tries to pay, gets an error, and leaves for the competition without warning.

The trap of manual monitoring

Checking the error log once a week is useless when your clients are trying to buy right now. Money does not wait for your support team to wake up.

Our solution: AI Payment Sentinel Agent

At LANZAESTUDIO, we develop an autonomous AI Agent, hosted directly in the root directory of your server, that audits your payment integrations in real time. It connects to your gateway API, analyzes failed attempts using Artificial Intelligence, and sends immediate alerts to your ecosystem.

  1. Environment Auditing: It verifies 24/7 that your API keys are correctly configured in a production environment and are not carrying over test credentials.
  2. AI Webhook Analysis: It reads and interprets gateway error codes and explains the technical failure to you in natural language.
  3. Firewall Exception Management: It detects if your hosting security rules are legitimately blocking payment callbacks.
  4. Critical Telegram Alerts: It notifies your mobile via a private bot in seconds, detailing which client failed and why.

The Real Impact on your B2B Sales

  • Zero silent losses: You detect and solve checkout blocks before they affect your daily billing.
  • Immediate technical resolution: You stop guessing what fails when migrating to production thanks to exact AI diagnostics.
  • Reputation protection: You proactively contact the corporate client who could not pay to offer an alternative, saving the contract.
